The CCEH gives its tunes as four-part scores; this page has the melody only, read from its MIDI file and checked against its incipit, and NoteFusion's engine wrote the solfa from the notes. Questions about Angel's Story

What is the doh of Angel's Story?

In this version, in G major, doh is G. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does Angel's Story start on?

It starts on m (B in G major), a pickup before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to m.

What words can be sung to Angel's Story?

Angel's Story is in the metre 7.6.7.6: lines of 7, 6, 7, 6 syllables. Words written in the same metre fit it, such as Abide, O Dearest Jesus, O Lord, I Am Not Worthy; check where the stresses fall before you sing them together.

Is Angel's Story in the public domain?

Yes. Arthur Henry Mann died in 1929; the tune was first published in 1881. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in the UK, the EU, the United States and Nigeria. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
